messages:
Ben (PM): Quick sync request — we need to align SDK + docs scope for the next roadmap sprint. Key surfaces: chat/completions, embeddings, rerank, function/tool-calling, and structured output. Who can take ownership of parity checklist?
Alice (DevEx): I can do a first pass on Python + TS parity. Priorities: 1) API signatures/types 2) canonical examples 3) changelog entries for breaking behaviors. Need list of breakable changes.
Chloe (Docs): Launch criteria request: for each surface we need example, minimal quickstart, one end-to-end sample app, and typed SDK snippets. Also a short note on limitations/compatibility. Can we decide which surfaces are "beta" vs "GA"?
Dan (Eng): From runtime side, function/tool-calling behavior will differ between hosted and private deployments (callback semantics + auth). Need to surface that in SDK docs. Also structured output requires a stable output schema in model responses for the examples to be deterministic.
Alice (DevEx): Agreed. Proposed parity checklist items (short):

- Python/TS method names + arg shapes
- Type definitions (TS .d.ts) and typed return values for common models
- Sync examples: streaming chat, function call, embedding batch, and rerank pipeline
- Changelog entry templates + migration notes

Can we get an owner for types and an owner for examples?
Chloe (Docs): I'll own canonical examples and quickstarts. @Alice please handover a sample TS + Python snippet for each surface by EOD Friday. I'll draft launch checklist with entries for testing, code review, and API docs review.
Emily (Design): For the TS examples we should include typed interfaces for structured output. Small design ask: show a minimal workflow for transforming model structured output -> typed object in the client. E.g.:

```ts
interface Invoice { id: string; total_cents: number; vendor: string; }
const resp = await client.chat.create({/*...*/});
const invoice: Invoice = parseInvoice(resp.structuredOutput);
```

That helps app devs onboard faster.
Dan (Eng): Note: parseInvoice needs to tolerate missing fields and minor schema drift — include helper fn in utils SDK. We'll add a small `validateSchema` util.
Ben (PM): Customer asks driving this: Acme wants structured outputs + typed TS examples. FinCorp asked for explicit function-calling docs + security notes for private deployments. Both are gating for sales conversations.
Alice (DevEx): On changelogs: we should standardize format. Proposed template: date, surface, type (feature/fix/breaking), migration note, example diff. I'll draft.
Chloe (Docs): Also include a short section in each doc page about "runtime differences" (hosted vs dedicated vs private) — Dan can supply the runtime caveats.
Dan (Eng): Will produce a short bullet list per feature. Expect PRs by Wed.
Ben (PM): Scope negotiation: we can't ship full parity for all surfaces this sprint. Proposal: ship GA for embeddings + basic chat/completions with streaming + function-calling beta docs + structured output beta (examples + helpers). Rerank to follow next sprint. Thoughts?
Emily (Design): Sounds reasonable. Keep the structured output examples narrow (invoices, order objects) so examples stay focused.
Alice (DevEx): I'll start a repo branch `sdk/docs-align/1718` with skeleton examples and types. I’ll push initial TS/py snippets tonight.
Chloe (Docs): I'll create the launch-checklist doc and link to the PRs.
Ben (PM): Action items: @Alice create branch + PR with types/examples by EOD; @Dan runtime caveats doc by Wed; @Chloe launch checklist + quickstarts draft by Thu. I'll schedule a short sync Fri 10am.
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: none — just a reminder to include SDK versioning step in release playbook.
Alice (DevEx): :thumbsup: will do.
Chloe (Docs): :white_check_mark:
Dan (Eng): :+1:
